Subject: Request: control crosswalk + evidence commitments for SOC 2/ISO review

Hannah,

Thanks for taking this call yesterday. As we move through FinServ's procurement process we need a technical-level crosswalk mapping Redwood controls to our requested SIG/SOC 2/ISO items, plus a clear commitments table for what artifacts you can deliver and estimated delivery dates.

Key asks:
- Mapping (control IDs) to FinServ questions (we'll reference the attached questionnaire in our portal).
- Artifact list and who on your team will own collection (POCs).
- Any items that are currently not collectable or require redaction.
- Expected delivery timeline (we're targetting vendor package by 2027-04-02).

Can you provide an initial draft by 2027-03-16? If there are blockers, call them out so procurement can raise them internally.

Regards,
Alan Price
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinServ Capital

2) Provide PDFs of SOC 2 report (2026), network/infra diagrams, and a committed artifact delivery matrix with owners.
3) Note any controls that require contractual confirmation (e.g., data residency proofs) and flag them separately.

Neha — please own the artifact list and evidence export (worksheet B).
Monica — handle legal / redaction notes and confirm anything that needs an approval before sharing.

We can hit Alan's 2027-03-16 draft milestone for the crosswalk + artifact matrix; final PDFs may follow on 2027-03-18. If timeline slips I'll escalate.

I'll attach the initial files as draft when ready.
